# Rustwell Foundry: map 1 layout (v0.3, art pass + wall-jump retune)

**Map id:** `rustwell_foundry` → `res://maps/rustwell_foundry/rustwell_foundry.tscn` (generated by `../../tools/gen_rustwell.py`).
**Premise:** The Rustwell Arms steel foundry, overrun and fenced off by quarantine. A truck loading yard, a rail spur, a racked
warehouse, the furnace hall and a fuel tank farm, all inside one walled compound. Grounded and gritty: asphalt, rust, soot-black brick, dusk sky.
**Footprint:** 88 m (x −44 to 44) × 66 m (z −30 to 36). Godot axes: +X east, **+Z south**, the Yard floor is y = 0.
**Single source of truth:** `layout_data.py` (all numbers below come from it). Sketch: `layout_sketch.png` (`../../tools/sketch_rustwell.py`).
Screenshots: `screenshots/`. Metrics: `../../docs/conventions.md`.

### What changed since v0.1 (G4M3N's review)
- **No zombie-proof perches.** Every raised surface has a zombie route (stairs, ramp or ≥ 2 m bridge). The **single dead end** is
  the ContainerC2 roof (one 6 m ramp, west side). It holds Chest1 and the WJ1 landing.
  - Rack tops are joined to the mezzanines by RackBridgeW/E (N end) and RackCrossBridge (S end).
  - The boxcars are joined to the footbridge by PlankBridgeBX1, plus BoxcarGangway (BX1↔BX2) and RampBX2 to the ground.
  - The pump house roof is reached by RampPipeRackN (from the pipe rack) and StairPumpRoof (west).
  - The Foundry gained CatwalkW, so the catwalks form a loop.
  - Unreachable-by-design tops: C1 is a 3-high stack (7.8 m). The furnace and flue reach the roof (13 m). The gate office is 4.5 m.
    T2/T3 are 6 m and T1 is 8 m. The truck and hopper car have **steep prism caps** (> 45°) so you can't stand on them.
    Walls are 8 m outdoors (above the best wall-kick reach) and run to the roof indoors (9 m / 13 m).
  - The v0.1 junk steps, dumpster and tanker were removed (the hopper car replaces the tanker).
- **D6 moved** to (16, 20) (A↔F mid-wall). **C2 is now a double container (4.9 m deep roof)** so the WJ1 kick lands instead of overshooting.
- **PowerWeaponSpot** moved to the Tank Farm, on the south side of the T1 ring catwalk (30, 3.0, 21.25).
- Every spawn is area-tagged. Doors carry cost / connects / opens_areas exports (contract v0.2).

## 2. Doors and opening order
All doors are `MapDoor` nodes at `NavigationRegion3D/Doors/<Dn>` (contract v0.2). While closed they block the player and the navmesh.

| Door | connects | Centre (x, z) | Width × height | cost | opens_areas |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| D1 Rail Gate | start ↔ rail_spur | (−16, 22) | 4.0 × 3.5 | 750 | rail_spur |
| D2 Warehouse Roller Door | start ↔ warehouse | (0, 8) | 5.0 × 4.5 | 750 | warehouse |
| D3 Foundry Side Door | rail_spur ↔ foundry | (−30, 4) | 3.5 × 3.5 | 1000 | foundry |
| D4 Furnace Passage | warehouse ↔ foundry | (−16, −20) | 3.0 × 3.0 | 1000 | foundry |
| D5 Loading Bay Shutter | warehouse ↔ tank_farm | (16, 3) | 4.0 × 3.5 | 1250 | tank_farm |
| D6 Fence Breach | start ↔ tank_farm | (16, 20) | 3.0 × 3.0 | 1250 | tank_farm |

Flow: Yard (rounds 1–3) → D1 / D2 → Foundry via D3 or D4 → Tank Farm via D5 or D6. With all of D1–D4 open you get the big ring A→B→E→C→A,
and D5 + D6 give A→C→F→A. Verified: with the doors opened one at a time (D1, D3, D2, D5), the reachable spawns always match the unlocked areas (5 → 7 → 8 → 10).

| Loop | Where | Length |

| L1 Yard loop | around the container block (W lane passes between the truck and the C2 ramp) | ~90 m |

| L3 Rack loop | around the rack block | ~84 m |

## 4. Chokepoints
Doors (3–5 m), the container slot (3.2 m), rack aisles (2.8–3.2 m), pump-house openings (3 m), stair feet (2.5–3 m). The navmesh erodes 0.5 m
per side, so every zombie path is ≥ 2.5 m wide physically. Clearance under decks is ≥ 2.3 m (agent height 2.0).

## 5. Verticality and wall-jump routes (retested 2026-10-19 against current player.gd)

Player.gd now has `jump_kind()` + `ground_jump_kick_lock` 0.15 s (one press = one jump). Measured kick peaks dropped ~0.4 m vs the greybox sim, so several routes were re-tuned in `layout_data.py` (nav / zombie routes kept intact).

**Before** (12:00 snapshot, old jump logic that could double-spend a ground press as a wall kick):

| Route | Intended kicks | Base Soldier / Scout |
|---|---|---|
| WJ1 Container Chimney | 1 | ✓ all policies |
| WJ2 Dock Slot | 2 | ✓ apex+hold |
| WJ3 Rack Aisle | 2 | ✓ early |
| WJ4 Flue Chimney | 3 | ✓ apex / early |
| WJ5 Pump Slot | 2 | ✓ all |

**After** (current `fps-starter/scripts/player.gd`, base profile; fewer-kick sweeps all fail):

| Route | Start | Target | Kicks | Soldier | Scout | Policies that land | Geometry tweak |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| WJ1 Container Chimney (A) | slot C1/C2, floor 0 | C2 roof 2.6 | **2** | ✓ 2.60 | ✓ 2.60 | apex (and peers) | C1 moved 1.5 m north → 4.7 m chimney gap |
| WJ2 Dock Slot (B) | dock 1.0 ↔ BX1 | BX1 roof 3.8 | 2 | ✓ 3.80 | ✓ 3.80 | apex+hold | unchanged (spring heels can do it in 1) |
| WJ3 Rack Aisle (C) | aisle R1/R2 | RackBridgeW 3.6 | 2 | ✓ 3.60 | ✓ 3.60 | apex | R2 / RackBridgeW widened +2 m east; start z −19 |
| WJ4 Flue Chimney (E) | furnace ↔ flue | CatwalkN lip 4.2 | 3 | ✓ 4.20 | ✓ 4.20 | apex | LipParapet 4.2→5.3 (2-kick landing blocked) |
| WJ5 Pump Slot (F) | valve wall ↔ pump | pump roof 4.0 | 2 | ✓ 4.00 | ✓ 4.00 | apex+hold | unchanged (spring heels can do it in 1) |

Unintended perches: Clip/ now has perimeter walls, columns above every wall / tall block / tank top to y=30, full-radius TipClip on T2/T3 (rim was perchable with spring heels), plus the earlier cone roofs and indoor Clip ceilings. Climb corridors (`climbs.json`) are re-run against base / spring_heels / kite_string / max_stack after each Clip change.


## 6. Sightlines
- Yard: 28 m N-S (the containers break the middle). Warehouse central aisle: 33 m. Rail Spur ground lane: 25 m.
- Foundry: from the crane bridge you see 28 m E-W and down into the pit. The furnace glow is the landmark.
- Tank Farm E lane: ~50 m, the longest sightline (fog 0.007 softens it).

## 8. Lighting and mood (art-pass target; the greybox has a first pass, see §11)
- **Time:** dusk under a heavy overcast. The sky is the existing `abandoned_tank_farm_05_2k.hdr` (shared, 0 MB extra) at energy 0.6 to 0.7, tinted cooler.
  The Sun (DirectionalLight3D) is low and warm (1.0, 0.72, 0.5), energy 0.9, the **only** directional shadow, max distance 60 m, 4 splits.
- **Outdoor:** sodium floodlights on 2 poles in the Yard and 1 in the Tank Farm (SpotLight3D, orange 2200 K). Shadows only on the Yard pair.
  The tank farm gets a blinking red aviation light on T1.
- **Warehouse:** cold flickering fluorescent strips (Poly Haven `mounted_fluorescent_lights`, emissive mesh + 4 to 6 unshadowed OmniLight3D).
  One shadowed SpotLight3D through the broken skylight onto the central aisle.
- **Foundry:** the hero lighting. The furnace mouth glows orange (OmniLight3D, energy 4, range 18, shadowed) with an emissive slag-pool decal in the pit.
  Hanging industrial lamps sit along the catwalks, and dust (GPUParticles3D, ≤ 200) drifts in the light.
- **Interiors darker than outside:** ReflectionProbe per building (`interior = true`, ambient = Constant, dark warm/cool colour, update once), so
  sky ambient doesn't flood the indoors. One WorldEnvironment for the whole map: fog 0.006 to 0.008 (warm grey), SSAO on, glow on, ACES tonemap,
  **SDFGI off, volumetric fog off, SSR off, SSIL off** (perf).
- Each spawn breach gets a dim red emissive marker (cheap, no light), and each door gets an amber "cost" sign light (emissive only).

**Built procedurally** (BoxMesh/CylinderMesh plus the textures above, like gen_main.py): walls, floors, containers, boxcars, tanker, racks,
catwalks, ramps, tanks, furnace and pump house. That keeps colliders simple and the navmesh clean.
**Shipped:** see `assets/assets_manifest.json` and `CREDITS.md` (82.5 MB CC0 downloads + Desi barricades). Dressing/ holds Marker3D slots (`BreachSlot_Spawn*`, `BreachSlot_Window_GateOffice`, `HeroCarSlot`, `RubbleSlot_*`); D1/D3/D4/D6 have `Visual/DesiSlot`. D2/D5 keep rollershutter_door. Auto-places Desi glbs when present under `assets/models/`.

**Left out on purpose:** `modular_factory_facade` (175k tris, 17.6 MB) and `modular_chainlink_fence` (89k tris) are too heavy for the benefit.
They're replaced by procedural walls and Fence006 alpha cards. Every asset gets logged in `maps/rustwell_foundry/CREDITS.md` when it's added (art pass).

## 10. Performance plan (target: 60 fps on a mid-range Windows PC, GTX 1660 / RX 580 class at 1080p)
- **Disk budget:** textures ~58 MB + new models ~57 MB ≈ **115 MB** (< 150 MB). Reused project assets cost 0. Imported VRAM-compressed textures are about 45 MB of VRAM.
- **Geometry:** the procedural blocks are **merged per area per material** into one MeshInstance3D each (about 5 areas × 6 materials ≈ 30 draw calls of
  architecture). Colliders stay separate box shapes. Target **≤ 600k visible tris and ≤ 1,200 draw calls** on screen at worst. Props use Godot's import auto-LOD
  (`lod_bias` 1), plus `visibility_range_end` 35 to 50 m (fade) on small clutter so it drops out early.
- **Occlusion:** OccluderInstance3D with Box/Quad occluders (no bake needed) for the building shells and the C|E, A|C and C|F walls, the containers, boxcars and T1.
  **Needs the project setting `rendering/occlusion_culling/use_occlusion_culling = true`** (G4M3N, engine side). The indoor/outdoor split makes this effective.
- **Lights:** 1 directional shadow + ≤ 4 shadowed omni/spot visible at once (furnace, skylight, 2 yard floods). Everything else is unshadowed with `distance_fade`.
  Shadow atlas 4096, soft shadow quality low.
- **Effects:** SSAO only (half res). No SDFGI, volumetric fog, SSR or SSIL. Particles ≤ 200 per emitter, ≤ 3 emitters.
- **Navmesh:** cell 0.25 over about 5,800 m² of floor plus decks. The full async bake runs at start and on each door. Bake time will be measured in verify (target < 1 s off-thread).
- **Verify (build step):** headless load with no errors, navmesh polygon count > 0 and path checks PlayerSpawn → every active spawn per unlock stage,
  a frame-time log from a scripted fly-through, and 1 overview plus 4 gameplay-height screenshots.
